body:
Third Experience With Cyclazodone
male, mid 20s
body weight 65 kg
past experiences: non-response to amphetamine and methylphenidate
16:48 - 39 mg cyclazodone (oral route)
HR 76 BPM
Today was an ordinary working day. I slept poorly (~6 hrs), I felt tired and demotivated all day. Negative thoughts, low self worth.
Let's see if this cheers me up.
I hope to see
- optimism
- improvement in long-range motivation/task saliency
- maybe sociability enhancement
16:47: it burns on my tongue (could also be that I am slightly dehydrated)
I'm expecting nothing to happen for next 1 hour or so, since this was my experience in the past.
17:23: nothing subjective, HR 100
17:44: Nothing really. Still a bit bored. Maybe less tired and depressed?
18:41: Nothing really. Scrolling the Internet is maybe a bit more fun. (Due to unrelated medical issues I had some pain)
18:53: mild stimulation
19:12: 112 BPM, mild stimulation - indistinguishable from coffee. My face feels slightly warmer?
19:24: Mild stimulation, not entirely pleasant. Reaction time is possibly improved (p = 0.03, I will redo analysis later), typing speed is definitely improved (112 -> 125 WPM)
20:04: Nothing interesting is happening. My typing speed is faster than before. It might be a mere training effect. I do feel a bit more focused, I look at the screen for longer without blinking and I could probably sit still for longer - but sadly this doesn't translate into any improved task saliency. The stuff I was hoping to get done today has still not been carried out.
The stuff I was hoping to get done today has still not been carried out.
20:15: Slight hunger, should probably eat something. A mild sense of discomfort.
21:06: Starting to feel bored again; still hungry. Maybe a bit of stimulation left? Reaction time is still a bit lower. Face feels a bit warm again; no flush cheeks in mirror. Body temperature 37.2 C, seems normal.
Conclusion: I don't think I'm going to continue using this. There's nothing wrong with it per se, and it is not a compound that I leave behind with disgust, but don't really see any strong advantages over caffeine, which both gives me stronger euphoria and has a more favourable safety profile. If the sociability improvements I experienced at a higher dosage appear again, it may be worth exploring further, but at this point it seems as though the only possible use I could get out of it would be recreational.
